label: single hardest line per verse, distilled from v1+v2 against the Sanskrit packet

lines.killer: I'm not asking — I'm already His.
lines.why: v1 hedged with setup ('this bow isn't me asking'); the killer drops setup — the whole verse in 7 words
v2's 'I'm Him, always was' explained; the killer trusts the reader — negation + assertion, nothing else

lines.killer: Yeah, it's all still here. Watch me not move.
lines.why: v2 narrated the threats; the killer keeps only the structure: admission, then stillness as defiance
v2 talked back at length; the killer is the refusal itself — misdirected gaze, dismissed authority

lines.killer: Death came. I said hey. It left.
lines.carries: namas alone defeats all four threats
lines.why: v2 listed every threat; the killer keeps the mechanism (salutation only) and the result (gone)

lines.killer: I didn't find bliss. I walked in.
lines.why: v2 explained the distinction; the killer IS the distinction — C1's crux as a two-beat line

lines.killer: Press play on the hymn, and separation ends.
lines.why: v2's 'song IS the vibe' names it; the killer gives the instruction — cause and effect in 8 words

lines.killer: Sit with His words. Bliss does the rest.
lines.why: v2's flowing section ran long; the killer splits agency correctly: you sit, bliss flows

lines.killer: Bliss has a password. Mine's samaya.
lines.why: v2 explained the covenant; the killer makes exclusion the hook — password states restricted access precisely

lines.killer: The world's on fire. He's the water. Instantly.
lines.why: v2 closed with meta-signoff; the killer closes with the cosmology: problem, agent, speed — no commentary needed
